feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 August 2026 4:13pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 18 August 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of Scotland as a developing frontal wave starts to affect the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, perhaps touching force 6 in the east overnight, decreasing 3 or 4 tomorrow morning, backing south or southwest later and occasionally 5 in places.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the east.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then rain arriving from the west this evening clearing to showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the south at first, veering west or northwest through the evening, veering north or northeast 4 or 5 overnight into Thursday and occasionally 6 in the northeast of the area. Backing northerly 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.
